evidence.reason: Line 205 treats every nonzero `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` exit as proof the path is outside Git. Git also exits nonzero when it refuses to inspect a repository, such as a checkout owned by another user (dubious ownership), so `require_outside_git` can accept a private overlay/audit path inside an actual checkout, contradicting its stated guard. The smallest compatible repair is to reject probe failures unless the failure establishes that no repository contains the path.
